notes: Network-wide reproduction of Tash's screening rule (NEE_VUT_REF_QC >= 0.25 on every day of a 'complete' year [all 365/366 calendar days present and passing], >= 5 complete years, US-Aud excluded). Reproduced 87 sites / 715 site-years vs. the framework's 62/505. Not tuned to force a match. 'Complete year' is interpreted as full calendar-day coverage (no missing days), not just all delivered days passing -- see docs/methods_memo.md.
